LanguageData.SSFTest_BearElixir.label: bear elixir
LanguageData.SSFTest_BearElixir.description: An elixir that transforms the drinker into a bear. 85% success chance.
LanguageData.SSFTest_ShiftScroll_Self.label: shift scroll (self)
LanguageData.SSFTest_ShiftScroll_Self.description: A scroll that transforms the user into a bear when used.
LanguageData.SSFTest_ShiftScroll_Target.label: shift scroll (target)
LanguageData.SSFTest_ShiftScroll_Target.description: A scroll that transforms the clicked target into a bear. Select a target to walk over and use.

LanguageData.SSFTest_Weapon_CursedBow.label: cursed bow
LanguageData.SSFTest_Weapon_CursedBow.description: A bow imbued with a curse. Targets hit by its arrows have a 40% chance of being polymorphed into a sheep.
LanguageData.SSFTest_Weapon_DarkBlade.label: Test: dark blade
LanguageData.SSFTest_Weapon_DarkBlade.description: A blade imbued with dark power. Equipping grants the dark knight transformation ability. Unequipping removes the ability.
LanguageData.SSFTest_Apparel_PhantomCloak.label: Test: phantom cloak
LanguageData.SSFTest_Apparel_PhantomCloak.description: A cloak imbued with phantom power. Wearing grants the phantom transformation ability. Removing it removes the ability.
